exposure: new ART legislation favoring single embryo transfer
cohort: The study included 420 live births (Group 1) and 1094 infants cared for in the NICU (Group 2) in Turkey, evaluating those born after medically assisted reproduction (MAR) pregnancies in the post-legislation era.
finding: Despite new legislation favoring single embryo transfer, multiple birth rates remained high in medically assisted reproduction (MAR) pregnancies, leading to unfavorable neonatal outcomes including increased risks of multiple births and prematurity.
